about: The context guard of a directory, read from guards.tsv as the executor writes it: the executor's package internal/guards runs these cases. file is the body of guards.tsv, null for no file; dirs maps a directory to [cap, restart] of the closest place above it, null for none.

cases.what: the closest place above wins, and a place holds only what lies under it
a broken line is passed over
of two places as long, the first
a place written with a closing slash holds what lies under it, not itself
the root holds every directory, and no directory is held by nothing
a line breaks where python breaks it, and a cap has spaces around it
